name: Green/Besh
description: Green/Besh was an Imperial Navy IPV-1 System Patrol Craft. In the year 0 ABY, the Green/Besh was stationed on the edge of the Mid Rim's Ringali Nebula alongside the IPV-1 Green/Aura and the Lancer-class frigate Rage at the Imperial Bavos-II military space platform Station 1B6/Green. It was armed with four turbolasers, could reach a speed of one thousand kilometers per hour, and acted as an inter-system patrol and customs craft. The Green/Besh was produced by the company Sienar Fleet Systems, and was 150 meters long.
